# Motion Director Film: product films and showreels made in code

Direct, animate, score and QA a finished short film in code. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

[SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Directs, animates, scores and QAs a finished short film entirely in code (Remotion or an HTML + GSAP frame renderer, encoded with ffmpeg), from a one-page brief through facts, concept, storyboard, style frames, an audio-first timing map, build, independent critic passes and a measured quality bar. Covers four modes: showreel (the craft is the subject), product (real UI rebuilt as live components), launch-story (characters carry the release) and explainer (one cause and effect, narrated). Use it whenever the user wants a promo, launch video, product film, sizzle reel, showreel, motion piece or animated explainer made in code, rendered to MP4 in one or more aspect ratios, with music, sound effects or voice, or asks to make a video "that holds up next to the best work". Also for reviewing or fixing such a film: sync drift, frozen stretches, unreadable type, invented claims, loudness.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/motion-director-film/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/motion-director-film`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $motion-director-film to make a finished short film from this brief: plan it, build it in code on one timeline, score it, and run critic passes until it clears the quality bar."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.
